summary: Round-5 fix verified: one-entry-per-day enforcement for Fatigue and Headache trackers. Executed 19 frontend test cases covering fatigue upsert/id-stability, dashboard quick-fatigue sharing, headache dialog prefill/overwrite/no-toggle, quick-headache navigation (no storage write), ?tab=headache deep link, legacy-entry migration (occurred default true), history pill + today tag, persistence after reload, and Settings 'Clear all data' regression. All 19 tests PASS.

issues: Console warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent — add DialogDescription for a11y (minor, non-blocking)
Recharts ResponsiveContainer width/height(-1) warning on initial mount when tab is hidden; cosmetic console noise only

critical_code_review_comments: storage.js headacheAPI: `severity: payload.occurred ? payload.severity || 'mild' : null` — good default. Numeric coercion `Number(payload.durationHours)` returns NaN if non-numeric string is passed; consider guarding with isFinite. Currently not a user-visible issue since the input is type=number.

Symptoms.jsx HeadacheTab: when dialog date is changed to a past date that has an entry, prefill works via onChangeDate. When date is switched to a date WITHOUT entry, form resets correctly — verified indirectly. Consider adding an explicit data-testid for the title to distinguish 'Log headache' vs 'Today's headache' modes.
Dashboard.jsx: headacheAPI import was correctly removed; quick-headache is now <Link to='/symptoms?tab=headache'> — verified no localStorage write on click.
Minor a11y: DialogContent missing aria-describedby (react-aria console warning).
seed_data_creation: Seeded legacy headache entry {id:'old1', date:'2026-04-20', severity:'mild', durationHours:2, notes:'pre-migration'} (no `occurred` field) to verify migration path — rendered correctly with 'mild' pill, not 'no headache'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Round-5 acceptance criteria verified on mobile viewport 390x844. Key invariant validated: storage entry id remains stable across re-saves for both fatigue and headache (one-per-day upsert). Dashboard quick-headache button does NOT write to localStorage — it only navigates to /symptoms?tab=headache (deep link honored). Legacy headache entries without `occurred` field default to occurred=true on read. Settings > 'Clear all data' > 'Clear everything' confirm wipes both thal.fatigue and thal.headache keys. Known non-blocking console warnings: Dialog missing aria-describedby, Recharts width/height(-1) when tab is hidden.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. All Round-5 requirements implemented correctly in /app/frontend/src/lib/storage.js (headacheAPI.setForDate upserts by date; list() defaults legacy `occurred` to true) and /app/frontend/src/pages/Symptoms.jsx (openDialog/onChangeDate prefills via byDate; conditional severity/duration; dynamic button label; today status line; useSearchParams for ?tab=headache) and /app/frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.jsx (quick-headache is Link, no logHeadache side-effect).
